newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1 bln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1 bln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday are expected to total $1 billion in 41 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $559 million in 20 sales, with a $92.2 million New York State Dormitory Authority deal through Merrill Lynch & Co. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 21 sales totaling $470 million are on the schedule. A $200 million New York City deal is the largest.
An additional 10 sales totaling $402 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesday depending on market conditions.
